---
title: "HW2 Q4(c) code"
format: gfm
editor: visual
---

```{r}
set.seed(123)

n <- 1e5
a <- 0.9
lambda_f <- 1000  
lambda_s <- 10     


# Bernoulli draw: TRUE = F, FALSE = S
B <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = a)

# One uniform draw for inverse-transform sampling
U <- runif(n)

# Inverse transform for the selected exponential component
T <- ifelse(B == 1,
            -log(1-U) / lambda_f,
            -log(1-U) / lambda_s)

# Empirical mean
emp_mean <- mean(T)

# Theoretical mean
theory_mean <- a / lambda_f + (1 - a) / lambda_s

# Threshold: 50 ms = 0.050 s
t0 <- 0.050

# Empirical P(T > 50 ms)
emp_tail <- mean(T > t0)

theory_tail <- a * exp(-lambda_f * t0) +
               (1 - a) * exp(-lambda_s * t0)

cat("Empirical mean:   ", emp_mean, "s\n")
cat("Theoretical mean: ", theory_mean, "s\n\n")

cat("Empirical P(T > 50 ms):   ", emp_tail, "\n")
cat("Theoretical P(T > 50 ms): ", theory_tail, "\n")

# Restrict displayed range so both components are easy to see
xmax <- 1
breaks <- seq(0, xmax, length.out = 100)

h <- hist(T[T <= xmax],
          breaks = breaks,
          plot = FALSE)

# Normalize using the FULL sample size n
# Histogram estimates the original density f(t)
binwidth <- diff(h$breaks)
density_full <- h$counts / (n * binwidth)

keep <- density_full > 0

plot(h$mids[keep], density_full[keep],
     log = "y",
     type = "h",
     lwd = 5,
     xlab = "Dwell time t (s)",
     ylab = "Density (log scale)",
     main = "Mixture of Exponential Dwell Times",
     ylim = c(1e-3, 1e3))

curve(
  a * lambda_f * exp(-lambda_f * x) +
    (1 - a) * lambda_s * exp(-lambda_s * x),
  from = 0,
  to = xmax,
  add = TRUE,
  lwd = 2,
  col = "red"
)


```
